# Verilog versions under fpga/verilog (generated by tools/verilog_versions_v1.py)

Testbenches (`tb_*`) do not count. `v4` / `v4c` and `v1` / `v1c` pairs are variants (the `c` one drops the addon chain for the carrier), not replacements, so they are not listed as older.
